fact: The report's DHIS2 data-quality table gives completeness of monthly facility reporting, as the share of expected monthly facility reports nationally, of 88 per cent in 2023, 90 in 2024 and 93 in 2025, with 79 per cent of regions at 90 per cent or more in 2025; it is a reporting-completeness figure, not a share of primary clinics entering their own data.
title: Analysis of Reproductive, Maternal, Newborn, Child and Adolescent Health Indicators for 2020-2025: Synthesis Report, Ethiopia
